story.heading: Slow-cooked mandi, served the way it is meant to be shared
paragraphs: Mandi is the centrepiece: rice cooked in the seasoned stock of the meat above it, then finished with fried onions, raisins and almonds. Chicken, lamb shank, goat and fish come out over the same fragrant rice.
Zurbian, the Yemeni biryani, sits alongside it, and the grill covers shawarma and gyro wraps for a quicker lunch. Everything on the menu is halal.

Confirm every item and in-store price with the owner, add anything missing (drinks, sides, desserts, Yemeni tea), and remove anything no longer served.
